name: run_002
why: The full 180 second shot table of knowledge/DEMO-SCRIPT.md section 3, played in one take on the build: the title, the crawl, the drive, the walk to the quay checkpoint, the gate and its three replies, the dock office and the boarding pass, the TALK fight won by talking, the deck hound won by one FIGHT, the ship's log save, the defeat that opens the game over, CONTINUE on the game over card, and the cabin the save puts back. Card t_785b61f0, and card t_fb7e8271 makes the table the plan the recorder reads (data/demo/shot_table.json, table full). It is not run_001: that one is 71 s and is pinned as the walk take, and this one is the submission take.
beat_source: knowledge/mechanics/PACING-AND-CUTSCENES.md section 9 (the 32 beat sheet) and knowledge/DEMO-SCRIPT.md section 3 (S1 to S6, second by second)

game.env_note: No PP_ROUTE_HOLD and no PP_SLICE: this run follows data/slice.json as a player does. The crawl hands to the drive, the drive to the arrival, the arrival's map trigger to the gate, the gate to the office, the office to the boarding, and the boarding to the deck, where the map's sailor trigger starts the second fight and Percy's office scene starts the third.

clock.note: 180 s is 10,800 steps at 60 a second, the game's own step rate (spec 05, spec 07)

seeds.note: title_flash is PP_TITLE_FLASH_SEED, so the attract's lightning flashes on the same steps. The encounter stream is the encounter row's own seed (data/encounters/all.json: tutorial_sailors 20261019, deck_hound 20261022, percy 771), which the build pins by data and not by this file.

talk.note: The TALK fight's replies are baked rows in this build (data/meta_bake.json, the replay leg of spec 19) unless tools/ai_bridge.py is up on 127.0.0.1:8791 with a model key in the environment. The run records whichever leg it actually took and says which in the verify file.

record.note: 768x720 is 3x the 256x240 screen. min_seconds 243.5 is the bottom of the take band (253.5 s plus or minus 10 s, the width the old 170 to 190 s band had around 180 s) and the end step is 15,210, which is 253.5 s.

checks.footstep_note: the floor, not the target: this is the take the nightly records (tools/play_demo.py with no arguments plays this script), and card t_ec7072b5's judged capture log carried 0 footstep cues, which is what 'Right reached a dialogue box and never the walk' looks like in the game's own log. One cue is the least this route cannot manage if its walk works at all: r044 holds Right for 14 steps onto the Deck Watch's tile at 4,7, which is 28 pixels of feet, and pp_overworld plays a footstep every PP_FOOTSTEP_PX (16) pixels walked. A larger number is not asked for here on purpose: the corridor walk at r078 claims fifteen tiles east from 3,7, and the navy_sailor stands at 11,7 of ship_small, so how far that hold actually gets is not something this worker could measure without a take
checks.note: palette_share_min is 0.55 and not run_001's 0.90: the quay and the battle field are drawn with roles the room palette set does not carry, and the measured fight frames sit at 0.39 to 0.40. The checks that catch a wrong take are the beats, the footsteps and the run's own failures.

events.note: down held 69 steps: nine tile rows, landing the feet in row 10 at py 154 (75 steps lands him in row 11 and the gate is never touched, which is what the 07:46 take did)

up held 5 steps: 10 px back to py 144, which puts the whole 10x6 feet box in row 9. The map lane moved morgan from (10,9) to (9,10) on 2026-10-30, straight in front of the checkpoint, and the shipped walk blocks on an actor (pp_world_blocked asks pp_overworld_actor_at for every tile the feet box touches), so a straight hold west stops on (10,10) with nothing underfoot: measured with tools/walker_bot.py, end px 158, footprint tile 10,10, and the confirm fires nothing at all. Row 9 is clear from the spawn column to column 8, which is why the walk goes round him instead of into him

left held 136 steps: seventeen tiles west along row 9 from the spawn column 24 (px 384, py 144) to px 112, which is tile (7,9), the tile one east of Morgan. 136 steps of 2 px is the 272 px between those columns and the shipped walk spends all of them: measured with tools/walker_bot.py against data/maps/all.json, 210 of 210 held steps moved, 0 blocked, 26 footstep cues at PP_FOOTSTEP_PX 16 (8 down, 1 up, 17 left), end px (112.0, 144.0) tile (7,9). Morgan stands on (6,9) (data/maps/all.json, actor morgan) and the route's morgan step is his own scene quay_morgan_encounter, started by the player's confirm, so the leg ends beside him and not on a trigger. The leg used to be 128 steps onto (8,10), the retired quay_gate_checkpoint tile: the quay only story (commit 28d407a2) took that trigger out of the map, so the confirm there fired nothing and the take stood still, which is the freeze the judge panel reported

Card t_a92c1007: this row used to hold down for 8 steps, walking off row 9 onto the retired checkpoint tile and facing south, away from Morgan. It holds nothing now. The hold above leaves the hero facing LEFT, because pp_world_face_input sets the facing from the held axis, and pp_world_reach_box extends PP_REACH 14 px west of the feet box: at px 112 the feet box is 115..124, so the reach box is 101..114, and Morgan's feet box on (6,9) is 99..108, which it overlaps. That overlap is what pp_overworld_actor_ahead finds, and finding him is what starts quay_morgan_encounter

Card t_a92c1007: the feet are on (7,9) and the hero faces west, so pp_overworld_actor_ahead reads Morgan on (6,9) before any trigger is asked and the press below starts his scene. No marker is named here: a map step never hands on (pp_route_take_next is called only by a scene or a fight ending), so 'step arrival handed to step gate' was a line this build can never print, and naming it made every later marker report a failure

Card t_a92c1007: confirm standing beside Morgan on (7,9) facing him. This is the press that starts quay_morgan_encounter, the route's morgan step, which is the only actor scene the quay carries (data/scenes/all.json:20; the route names it at data/slice.json route step id morgan, player true). The page presses below turn the say pages that scene opens. The press used to fire quay_gate_checkpoint on (8,10), a trigger the quay only story deleted, so nothing opened and the take froze

Card t_785b61f0: the ONE press that closes Morgan's talk box answer, and the only press this leg needs after the three say pages. quay_morgan_encounter's command list is face, face, sfx, flash, say quay_morgan_pre, talk, wait 20, battle morgan_gate (data/scenes/all.json:20), so the build opens no choice page and no bluff reply page here. The seven rows this replaces pressed a No pass. / Crew list. choice and a four press bluff reply, both of which belonged to quay_gate_checkpoint, a scene the quay only story deleted, so those presses were aimed at boxes the build cannot open. pp_talk_persona.gml:633 says the answer is drawn until the player confirms, so this row waits on the answer's own log line rather than on a guessed second: `PP: talk scene answer, npc morgan` lands in about 0.05 s on the replay leg and inside the 12 s PP_TALK_TIMEOUT on a live bridge, and marker_wait_s 15 holds the tape for a slow one instead of firing into the battle.
